The legendary gangster [[Diago Hixan]] led a '''gang''' on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The gang fought with an up-and-coming [[Voidhound|smuggler]] during his [[search for Nok Drayen's treasure]].<ref name="TOR" />
